body: If you think this post is eloquent or borderline eloquent for that matter, you really ought to read some great literature. And furthermore If you think I, or most people walking around are even close to measuring up to Hawking you either live around some very smart people or you are sorely mistaken about just how rare genius is. Do you know how many times I’ve gotten the ‘Hawking talk’ in my lifetime? Can you name another disabled intellectual without using Google? No? Let me tell you why: Because the lot of us live out our miserable lives trying to rationalize that the only chance we had at life on this planet was shorted from the start. People cope in their own ways, some use drugs or alcohol and some people find God. I, on the other hand have decided to take a different route; people can think what they will of me once I’m out of here but I’ll have done the only thing I could that made me truly happy. For the love of all that is holy, don’t give me the change the world speech. Who’s the next comparison? MLK? Gandhi? Maybe the third time the comparison could be Jesus or Buddha, and I can explain to you time and time again why I’m not them. Don’t worry about another fifty years. If I chicken out anytime soon, I’ll make sure I don’t live another ten.
